one_line: The paper proposes a feasibility study and 10-year roadmap for implementing the ISO 50001 and AEMAS energy-management standards across major energy-using units in Vietnam, referencing cement and petrochemical sectors only as benchmark examples rather than applying anything in a specific continuous-flow production plant.
